text:
maria: Quick help — HarborTrust legal is asking for SOC 2 + ISO artifacts and a vulnerability attestation for the POC. They need something they can hand to procurement by Friday EOD. @ashley can you confirm what we can share and any signed-letter options? cc @sam
ashley: We can provide: SOC2 summary (scope & controls matrix), ISO27001 scope/documents, KMS metadata (no key material), and a vuln attestation letter. We do NOT share raw pentest reports without redaction/consent. We can sign an attestation on letterhead.
mar ia: :thumbsup: great. They also want KMS key origin/rotation proof and a short list of mitigations for any recent high findings. Legal explicitly asked for a signed letter + something showing rotation timeline.
ashley: Got it. Proposed audit package:
- soc2-summary.pdf (system description + controls mapping)
- iso27001-scope.pdf
- kms-metadata-redacted.json
- vuln-attestation-letter.pdf (signed)
- change-log-samples (cloudtrail snippet)
We can redact sensitive details.
sam: FYI the POC ran in eu-west-1 on a demo dedicated instance. HarborTrust also asked about 6mo dedicated pricing and whether we can commit to encryption-at-rest with their KMS.
maria: They want a 6mo estimate for a small dedicated pool (2x A100 equivalent). @ravi any quick ops estimate?
ravi: Ballpark reserved pricing for 2x A100-class is about $45k/mo list. We can offer a 20% POC discount for the first 3 months if sales approves. Quick calc snippet:
```
list_monthly = 45000
poc_discount = 0.20
effective = list_monthly * (1 - poc_discount)
# effective ~= 36000/mo for first 3 months
```
ashley: For delivery, what does HarborTrust prefer? Secure SFTP, presigned S3 + passphrase, or a vendor portal upload? We should avoid sending raw reports by email.
maria: HarborTrust legal prefers SFTP or encrypted link. I'll confirm today. ETA for artifacts?
ashley: I can assemble and upload to a secure bucket tomorrow COB. I'll include a redaction note and the attestation text. Sample attestation (for legal review):
```
Redwood Inference Attestation
Date: 2025-03-10
To whom it may concern,
This letter attests that Redwood Inference completed internal vulnerability scanning and assessed third-party scan results on 2025-03-05 to 2025-03-09. No unresolved critical vulnerabilities were present at the time of assessment. High findings were mitigated or have in-flight mitigations with compensating controls in place. This attestation does not constitute a full third-party penetration test report.
Signed,
Ashley K. (Head of Security)
Redwood Inference
```
audit-bot: Automated: soc2-summary generated at 1975554400 and uploaded to secure bucket (redacted).
maria: Perfect — please add a one-line summary for procurement explaining redactions and the path to request full reports under NDA. I'll confirm delivery method with HarborTrust and loop legal if they insist on full reports. Thanks all.
